description: This file defines a 'Toast' UI component for a LightningJS-based application, responsible for showing transient top-banner notifications for info and error messages with show and hide methods.

classes.name: Toast
classes.description: A component for displaying transient notification banners at the top of the interface.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the toast message with optional type and duration, then auto-hides after specified duration.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the toast message with a slide-up animation.
